source: User: capacity may improve as we run longer; this is a core reason for indefinite operation. Capacity need not be discovered immediately; SOC should be known as soon as possible.

supersedes.scope: The unexecuted 900 s capacity deadline and 900 s experiment stop. Preserve that original plan and all earlier failed results unchanged.
supersedes.timing: Declared before any new candidate inference; not an extension selected after seeing its outcome.

unchanged.mechanism: Exactly the frozen two public logQ components versus coincident control; no tuned starts, pruning, inflation or noise changes.
unchanged.uncertainty: Local precision does not qualify accuracy or coverage. Unresolved capacity remains explicit and must not be advertised as learned.

priority.SOC: Measure earliest available hard/preferred point accuracy and retention across later stimulus; do not infer trustworthy qualification from a lucky initial point.
priority.capacity: Measure acquisition and retention over informative chronological use. The numerical target is not a startup deadline. Preserve unresolved status while evidence is insufficient or approximation bias remains.
priority.indefinite_operation: Bounded storage/work and continued ability to learn later are core requirements. A finite trajectory does not prove all-prefix numerical health or eventual convergence.

next_experiment.scope: One two-arm comparison on the complete existing Cell B 2100 s trace, with 900 s diagnostic, 1800 s late-informative and 2100 s weak-tail checkpoints.
next_experiment.capacity_decision: Report threshold attainment and error changes over time. A miss at 900 s or 2100 s alone does not prove eventual failure or justify promotion. Classify measured learning, retention, plateau/regression, representation/weighting failure and remaining uncertainty.
next_experiment.stop: Stop at the predeclared 2100 s. Preserve the first outputs and decide what they establish; no automatic time/count/start sweep.

future_longer_streams: A later duration experiment must define a continuous physical trajectory, unique ordered inputs and fresh observation noise where applicable. Do not concatenate the saved CSV as if plant states and noise magically reset; do not treat repeated posterior evidence as new observations. Separate elapsed duration, stimulus diversity and retained information.
limits: More informative use can improve capacity, but repeating weak data or carrying a biased overconfident approximation need not do so. SOC and capacity availability, point accuracy, local precision, hard support and validated coverage remain distinct.
